name: space-playground.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground.scss — MANIFEST for the Earth Playground route
//  (shadow-scoped via ?inline): a fullscreen Three.js Earth/Moon canvas
//  with a right-side "space panel" of WebGL sliders. Split by surface into
//  space-playground/ partials (imported below):
//    _view     :host + canvas + no-WebGL fallback
//    _loader   sci-fi boot overlay (rings, counter, stages)
//    _panel    right-side WebGL controls panel (desktop ≥1024px)
//    _reopen   floating Experience-Settings reopen button
//    _music    native audio player bar
//  The panel is desktop-only; on smaller screens the view is the canvas
//  alone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';
@import '../../core/sass/base/structure';

$_B_SP: 'sp';
$_B_SPP: '#{$_B_SP}-panel';

@import 'space-playground/view';
@import 'space-playground/loader';
@import 'space-playground/panel';
@import 'space-playground/reopen';
@import 'space-playground/music';
